worldcombat.skill.eeriespell.summary: A psychic assault on memory: deals special damage, drains 3 PP from the target's last used move, and leaves any target briefly unable to act reliably.
worldcombat.skill.eeriespell.description: On hit, drains %1$s PP from the target's last used move (Pokemon only) and leaves any target carrying Eerie for %2$s s.
A target carrying Eerie has a %1$s%% chance to fumble each attempt to act.
worldcombat.skill.eeriespell.timing: Windup %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
Only attack within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
When on, a stationed companion leaves its post to cast the spell; when off it stays put.
